properties.name: spring.datasource.url
properties.description: A repository with a `@Query` join: SQL only, so it exists only when the application has a database (the in-memory store has no joins).

methods.name: cardsSince
methods.query: select b.title, a.name as author_name, b.year from {Book} b join {Author} a on a.{Author.id} = b.{Book.author} where b.year >= :year order by b.year, b.title
